integrity: The proof is self-contained; a standalone Python dynamic-programming checker corroborates the claims in finite ranges, without replacing the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Binary alphabet and exactly two ones only; distinct self-shuffle roots, not interleaving multiplicities. The r=1 aggregate count was previously established in 2023. Historical priority remains qualified; no theorem for unrestricted binary words or general Hamming weights.
title: Exact root-multiplicity spectrum of binary weight-two shuffle squares
